sources.text: For source transparency, at least 80 percent of correct answers should show a supporting source snippet. For answer-not-present questions, the system should avoid inventing facts at least 90 percent of the time. For numeric spreadsheet questions, the system should report exact values from the workbook and avoid rounding unless asked. Failure Modes to Watch The retriever may return a semantically similar but wrong document when multiple files discuss the same feature. The model may cite a filename even when the retrieved snippet does not support the statement. Spreadsheet rows may be missed if a sheet is too large and relevant rows are split away from headers. Document filename: 01_product_requirements.docx INSIGHT.AI Product Requirements Document Version 2.4 - Demo Corpus Executive Summary INSIGHT.AI is a document assistant for retrieval augmented generation over uploaded business documents. The product goal is to let a user upload project material, create a searchable collection, and ask grounded questions with visible source evidence. The demo release is designed for small to medium public documents. It is not intended for confidential legal, medical, financial, or customer records because the final language model answer may be generated by an external model provider. The product success target for the demo is to answer at least 85 percent of f...

Non-Functional Requirements NFR-001: The demo must run on a low-cost EC2 instance for portfolio evaluation, with the understanding that indexing may be slower on very small machines. NFR-002: The browser interface should remain simple enough for a non-technical evaluator to upload documents and ask questions without setup instructions inside the app. NFR-003: The backend should expose explicit health checks so deployment problems can be diagnosed through curl before testing the UI. NFR-004: The repository should be small, clean, and free of generated local artifacts. NFR-005: The application should make retrieval evidence visible to reduce hallucination risk and improve trust. The system should be tested with exact fact questions, numeric spreadsheet questions, multi-document comparison questions, ambiguous questions, and answer-not-present questions. A good result is not only a fluent answer. The retrieved source snippet must support the answer.
